input.title: Test that thoughts do not shift y position after first render
input.body:
There are a few bugs that involve a thought's initial y position changing and causing it to drift slightly up or down as it fades in. The test cases vary depending on whether the thought is the last subthought or not, triggering the additional cliff margin, and the timing of measuring the DOM. Given the sensitivity of this logic, it would be great to get test coverage of this behavior to help avoid future regressions.

Test cases: 

- #2783
- #3097
- #3310
- #3647
- #3671

What would be a good way to test this? I was thinking the y position of each thought could be read after its initial render and at the end of its animation to make sure it is unchanged. This might be complicated by the fact that animations are disabled in Puppeteer. Let me know what you think would work. 

Ideally we find a way to test this without re-enabling the full animations and thus slowing down the tests.
